Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent full-body school mascot illustration for a local freshman guide website.
Input image 1 is the edit target, a character sheet supplied by the user.
Primary request: extract ONLY the main large central full-body female mascot from this sheet, on a genuinely transparent background. Retain the original character artwork as faithfully as possible. Remove all surrounding text, the right-hand detail panels, birds floating outside the character, campus buildings, red monument in the background, water beneath the shoes, palette diamonds and poster layout.
Invariants: preserve the face and bright blue eyes, long flowing indigo/navy hair, smiling expression, inviting outstretched hand, other hand holding the navy book, white and navy uniform with short pleated skirt, long wave-patterned cape, blue tie and red ribbons, circular bridge badges and chains, red angular bridge hair ornament, and both white/navy high-top sneakers. Keep the same pose and proportions. Do not invent a new character, simplify the costume, crop hair or shoes, or add typography.
Composition: complete head-to-shoes character centered in a portrait canvas, with transparent padding around the outermost cape/hair/hand/feet. Clean detailed anti-aliased edges; original illustrated colors; transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted into image, no drop shadow, no background.
notes: Generated derivative of supplied artwork; no independently verified official new mascot name or approval. No project/original-author API key used.
